workload.regulatory_scope: EU AI Act Art. 50 / GB 45438 Mandatory AI Content Labeling & Enterprise Model Provenance Audit
workload.model_profile: 70B FP8 Enterprise LLM (Baseline Unwatermarked HumanEval Code Pass@1: 82.4%, Base TPOT: 8.1 ms)
workload.attack_scenario: 200-Token Output Subjected to 30% Word-Swap / Dipper Paraphrase Attack at Strict FPR <= 0.1%

tiers.name: Tier 1: 事后被动文本分类器 (GPTZero / RoBERTa 困惑度检测 · 19.5% 误伤率)
tiers.name_en: Tier 1: Post-Hoc Passive Classifier (RoBERTa / Perplexity Detector -> 19.5% FPR)
tiers.watermark_mechanism: Zero generation-time signal; trains external BERT/RoBERTa classifier on surface perplexity & burstiness
tiers.code_and_speculative_safety: Does not alter generation, but completely unreliable as legal evidence (false-flags formal human writing)
tiers.recommended_for: Never use passive post-hoc classifiers for regulatory compliance or academic/legal accusation (only 41.2% TPR at 0.1% FPR, collapsing to 18.5% under light editing).

tiers.name: Tier 2: KGW 红绿词表硬偏置水印 (一刀切 +δ=2.0 -> 写代码准确率暴跌 -16.8 pts)
tiers.name_en: Tier 2: Naive KGW Green/Red List Logit Bias (+delta=2.0 -> -16.8pt Code Pass@1 Crash)
tiers.watermark_mechanism: Hashes sliding n-gram window to split vocab 50/50 into Green/Red; adds fixed +2.0 logit bias to all Green tokens
tiers.code_and_speculative_safety: Corrupts low-entropy syntax tokens (forces wrong brackets/keywords in Python/SQL/JSON) + Host CPU LogitsProcessor bottleneck (2.4ms)
tiers.recommended_for: Creative fiction or casual prose only; strictly banned on coding assistants, SQL generators, or structured JSON APIs due to -16.8pt syntax corruption.

tiers.name: Tier 3: 无损分布保持水印 (Google SynthID 锦标赛采样 / Gumbel-Max 耦合)
tiers.name_en: Tier 3: Distortion-Free Distribution-Preserving Watermark (SynthID Tournament / Gumbel-Max)
tiers.watermark_mechanism: Multi-layer tournament sampling / Gumbel-Max PRF coupling that preserves exact expected token distribution E[P_wm] = P_orig
tiers.code_and_speculative_safety: Mathematically distortion-free on single-token distribution, but still adds 0.85ms CPU/GPU sync and breaks deterministic Temp=0 greedy code
tiers.recommended_for: General natural-language APIs running stochastic sampling (Temperature >= 0.7).

tiers.name: Tier 4: GPU 融合熵自适应门控 SynthID (H<0.35 代码自动旁路) + 投机验证集成 + C2PA 签名
tiers.name_en: Tier 4: GPU-Fused Entropy-Gated SynthID (H<0.35 Code Bypass) + Speculative Integration + C2PA
tiers.watermark_mechanism: Fused Triton/CUDA sampler computes token Shannon entropy H(p); applies 3-layer SynthID tournament only when H >= 0.35 + C2PA metadata manifest
tiers.code_and_speculative_safety: 100% bypasses deterministic code/JSON syntax tokens (-0.1pt loss) + Native EAGLE-3 speculative verifier coupling (0.08ms overhead!)
tiers.recommended_for: Production enterprise LLM & multimodal APIs requiring EU AI Act / GB 45438 compliance with zero code degradation (-0.1pt) and 0.08ms latency overhead.
